brief:
The United States rejected an Israeli demand for a permanent military presence in southern Lebanon, according to Shehab Wire. A State Department official said such a deployment would contradict commitments outlined in the framework agreement and undermine prospects for regional peace.

The statement directly challenged positions taken by Israeli officials on the terms of any ceasefire arrangement. Hebrew Channel 12 first reported the American response, which underscores disagreement between Washington and Jerusalem over the scope and duration of Israeli forces in Lebanese territory.
